question: What is today's total net sales?
sql:
SELECT
  SUM(SaleNetAmount)          AS TodaySales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceId)   AS Bills,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerId)  AS UniqueCustomers
FROM dbo.VwAISalesData
WHERE InvoiceDt = CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
note: Use InvoiceDt from VwAISalesData. SaleNetAmount is net sales after tax.

question: What is MTD net sales?
sql:
SELECT
  SUM(SaleNetAmount)          AS MTDNetSales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceId)   AS Bills,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerId)  AS UniqueCustomers
FROM dbo.VwAISalesData
WHERE InvoiceDt >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
  AND InvoiceDt <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
note: MTD = 1st of current month to today. InvoiceDt is the sale date.

question: What is YTD net sales?
sql:
SELECT
  SUM(SaleNetAmount)        AS YTDNetSales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceId) AS Bills
FROM dbo.VwAISalesData
WHERE InvoiceDt >= DATEFROMPARTS(
    CASE WHEN MONTH(GETDATE()) >= 4 THEN YEAR(GETDATE()) ELSE YEAR(GETDATE()) - 1 END,
    4, 1)
  AND InvoiceDt <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
note: YTD uses Indian FY: April 1 of current or previous year depending on current month.

question: What is QTD net sales?
sql:
SELECT
  SUM(SaleNetAmount)        AS QTDNetSales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceId) AS Bills
FROM dbo.VwAISalesData
WHERE InvoiceDt >= CASE
    WHEN MONTH(GETDATE()) IN (4,5,6)    THEN DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), 4,  1)
    WHEN MONTH(GETDATE()) IN (7,8,9)    THEN DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), 7,  1)
    WHEN MONTH(GETDATE()) IN (10,11,12) THEN DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), 10, 1)
    ELSE DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), 1, 1)
  END
  AND InvoiceDt <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
note: QTD uses Indian FY quarters: Q1=Apr-Jun, Q2=Jul-Sep, Q3=Oct-Dec, Q4=Jan-Mar.

question: Show me top 5 branches by net sales this month
sql:
SELECT TOP 5
  b.BranchShortName       AS Branch,
  SUM(s.SaleNetAmount)    AS NetSales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.InvoiceId) AS Bills
FROM dbo.VwAISalesData s
JOIN dbo.VwAIBranch     b ON s.BranchId = b.BranchId
WHERE s.InvoiceDt >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
  AND s.InvoiceDt <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY b.BranchShortName
ORDER BY NetSales DESC
note: VwAISalesData has BranchId not BranchAlias — always JOIN VwAIBranch ON BranchId for branch name.

question: Net sales by all branches this month
sql:
SELECT
  b.BranchShortName       AS Branch,
  SUM(s.SaleNetAmount)    AS NetSales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.InvoiceId)  AS Bills,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.CustomerId) AS Customers
FROM dbo.VwAISalesData s
JOIN dbo.VwAIBranch     b ON s.BranchId = b.BranchId
WHERE s.InvoiceDt >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
  AND s.InvoiceDt <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY b.BranchShortName
ORDER BY NetSales DESC
note: All branches ranked. BranchShortName from VwAIBranch is the display name.

question: Compare this month vs last month sales by branch
sql:
SELECT
  b.BranchShortName AS Branch,
  SUM(CASE
    WHEN s.InvoiceDt >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
     AND s.InvoiceDt <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
    THEN s.SaleNetAmount ELSE 0 END) AS ThisMonth,
  SUM(CASE
    WHEN s.InvoiceDt >= DATEADD(MONTH,-1, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1))
     AND s.InvoiceDt <  DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
    THEN s.SaleNetAmount ELSE 0 END) AS LastMonth
FROM dbo.VwAISalesData s
JOIN dbo.VwAIBranch     b ON s.BranchId = b.BranchId
GROUP BY b.BranchShortName
ORDER BY ThisMonth DESC
note: Side-by-side MTD vs full previous month comparison using conditional SUM.

question: How many unique customers bought this month?
sql:

FROM dbo.VwAISalesData
WHERE InvoiceDt >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
  AND InvoiceDt <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
note: Unique customer count = COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerId) from VwAISalesData.

question: How many unique customers bought today?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerId) AS UniqueCustomers

note: Today's unique buyers.

question: What is the daily sales trend this month?
sql:
SELECT
  InvoiceDt                    AS SaleDate,
  SUM(SaleNetAmount)           AS NetSales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceId)    AS Bills,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerId)   AS Customers
FROM dbo.VwAISalesData
WHERE InvoiceDt >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
  AND InvoiceDt <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY InvoiceDt
ORDER BY InvoiceDt
note: Day-by-day trend for current month. Good for line chart.

question: Show monthly sales trend for last 6 months
sql:
SELECT
  FORMAT(InvoiceDt,'MMM yyyy')              AS Month,
  YEAR(InvoiceDt)*100 + MONTH(InvoiceDt)   AS SortKey,
  SUM(SaleNetAmount)                        AS NetSales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceId)                 AS Bills
FROM dbo.VwAISalesData
WHERE InvoiceDt >= DATEADD(MONTH,-6,
        DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()),MONTH(GETDATE()),1))
  AND InvoiceDt < DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()),MONTH(GETDATE()),1)
GROUP BY FORMAT(InvoiceDt,'MMM yyyy'), YEAR(InvoiceDt)*100 + MONTH(InvoiceDt)
ORDER BY SortKey
note: Last 6 complete months trend. SortKey ensures correct chronological order.

question: Top 10 customers by net sales this month
sql:
SELECT TOP 10
  c.CustomerFirstName + ' ' + c.CustomerLastName AS CustomerName,
  c.ContactMobile   AS Mobile,
  c.City,
  SUM(s.SaleNetAmount)        AS NetSales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.InvoiceId) AS Bills
FROM dbo.VwAISalesData        s
JOIN dbo.VwAICustomerDetails  c ON s.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
WHERE s.InvoiceDt >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
  AND s.InvoiceDt <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY c.CustomerFirstName, c.CustomerLastName, c.ContactMobile, c.City
ORDER BY NetSales DESC
note: Join VwAISalesData with VwAICustomerDetails on CustomerId for customer name and contact.

question: Net sales by category this month
sql:
SELECT
  i.InvCategoryName    AS Category,
  SUM(s.SaleNetAmount) AS NetSales,
  SUM(s.Quantity)      AS Qty
FROM dbo.VwAISalesData s
JOIN dbo.VwMstItems    i ON s.ItemId = i.ItemId
WHERE s.InvoiceDt >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
  AND s.InvoiceDt <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY i.InvCategoryName
ORDER BY NetSales DESC
note: Join VwAISalesData with VwMstItems on ItemId to get category. InvCategoryName is the category column.

question: Net sales by department this month
sql:

question: Top 10 best-selling items by quantity this month
sql:
SELECT TOP 10
  i.ArticleNo,
  i.InvCategoryName  AS Category,
  i.SupplierAlias    AS Supplier,
  i.ItemMRP          AS MRP,
  SUM(s.Quantity)    AS QtySold,
  SUM(s.SaleNetAmount) AS NetSales
FROM dbo.VwAISalesData s
JOIN dbo.VwMstItems    i ON s.ItemId = i.ItemId
WHERE s.InvoiceDt >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
  AND s.InvoiceDt <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY i.ArticleNo, i.InvCategoryName, i.SupplierAlias, i.ItemMRP
ORDER BY QtySold DESC
note: Use VwMstItems.ArticleNo for article number. SupplierAlias is the supplier short name.

question: Top 10 suppliers by net sales this month
sql:

question: Sales by salesperson this month
sql:
SELECT
  sp.SalesPersonName          AS SalesPerson,
  SUM(s.SaleNetAmount)        AS NetSales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.InvoiceId) AS Bills,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.CustomerId)AS Customers
FROM dbo.VwAISalesData   s
JOIN dbo.VwAISalesPerson sp ON s.SalesPersonId = sp.SalesPersonId
WHERE s.InvoiceDt >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
  AND s.InvoiceDt <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY sp.SalesPersonName
ORDER BY NetSales DESC
note: Join VwAISalesData with VwAISalesPerson on SalesPersonId. SalesPersonName is the display name.

question: What is the average bill value this month?
sql:
SELECT
  SUM(SaleNetAmount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceId),0) AS AvgBillValue,
  COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceId)   AS TotalBills,
  SUM(SaleNetAmount)          AS TotalSales
FROM dbo.VwAISalesData
WHERE InvoiceDt >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
  AND InvoiceDt <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
note: Average bill value = Total sales / Count of distinct invoices. NULLIF prevents divide-by-zero.

question: Show me YTD vs last year same period net sales
sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE
    WHEN InvoiceDt >= DATEFROMPARTS(
        CASE WHEN MONTH(GETDATE())>=4 THEN YEAR(GETDATE()) ELSE YEAR(GETDATE())-1 END, 4, 1)
     AND InvoiceDt <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
    THEN SaleNetAmount ELSE 0 END) AS YTD_Sales,
  SUM(CASE
    WHEN InvoiceDt >= DATEFROMPARTS(
        CASE WHEN MONTH(GETDATE())>=4 THEN YEAR(GETDATE())-1 ELSE YEAR(GETDATE())-2 END, 4, 1)
     AND InvoiceDt <= DATEADD(YEAR,-1, CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
    THEN SaleNetAmount ELSE 0 END) AS LY_YTD_Sales
FROM dbo.VwAISalesData
note: YTD = April 1 current FY to today. LY = same FY period one year back. Indian FY April start.

question: Total stock quantity and MRP value by branch
sql:
SELECT
  b.BranchShortName              AS Branch,
  SUM(st.StockQty)               AS TotalQty,
  SUM(st.StockQty * i.ItemMRP)   AS MRPValue
FROM dbo.VwAIStockData  st
JOIN dbo.VwAIBranch     b  ON st.BranchId = b.BranchId
JOIN dbo.VwMstItems     i  ON st.ItemId   = i.ItemId
GROUP BY b.BranchShortName
ORDER BY MRPValue DESC
note: VwAIStockData has StockQty per item per branch. Multiply by ItemMRP for value.

question: Stock quantity and value by category
sql:
SELECT
  i.InvCategoryName              AS Category,
  SUM(st.StockQty)               AS TotalQty,
  SUM(st.StockQty * i.ItemMRP)   AS MRPValue
FROM dbo.VwAIStockData st
JOIN dbo.VwMstItems    i  ON st.ItemId = i.ItemId
GROUP BY i.InvCategoryName
ORDER BY MRPValue DESC
note: Stock summary by category. VwAIStockData has current live stock; ItemMRP from VwMstItems.

question: Which items are out of stock?
sql:
SELECT
  i.ArticleNo,
  i.InvCategoryName  AS Category,
  i.SupplierAlias    AS Supplier,
  i.ItemMRP          AS MRP,
  SUM(st.StockQty)   AS StockQty
FROM dbo.VwAIStockData st
JOIN dbo.VwMstItems    i ON st.ItemId = i.ItemId
GROUP BY i.ArticleNo, i.InvCategoryName, i.SupplierAlias, i.ItemMRP
HAVING SUM(st.StockQty) <= 0
ORDER BY i.InvCategoryName, i.ArticleNo
note: Items with zero or negative total stock across all branches.

question: How many new customers were added this month?
sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS NewCustomers
FROM dbo.VwAICustomerDetails
WHERE CreatedOn >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
  AND CreatedOn <  DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1))
note: New customers = CreatedOn in current month from VwAICustomerDetails.

question: Bill count by branch today
sql:
SELECT
  b.BranchShortName           AS Branch,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.InvoiceId) AS Bills,
  SUM(s.SaleNetAmount)        AS NetSales
FROM dbo.VwAISalesData s
JOIN dbo.VwAIBranch    b ON s.BranchId = b.BranchId
WHERE s.InvoiceDt = CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY b.BranchShortName
ORDER BY Bills DESC
note: Today's bill count per branch. COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceId) = number of bills.

question: Net sales by category for last 3 months trend
sql:
SELECT
  FORMAT(s.InvoiceDt,'MMM yyyy')            AS Month,
  YEAR(s.InvoiceDt)*100 + MONTH(s.InvoiceDt) AS SortKey,
  i.InvCategoryName                          AS Category,
  SUM(s.SaleNetAmount)                       AS NetSales
FROM dbo.VwAISalesData s
JOIN dbo.VwMstItems    i ON s.ItemId = i.ItemId
WHERE s.InvoiceDt >= DATEADD(MONTH,-3,
        DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()),MONTH(GETDATE()),1))
  AND s.InvoiceDt < DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()),MONTH(GETDATE()),1)
GROUP BY FORMAT(s.InvoiceDt,'MMM yyyy'),
         YEAR(s.InvoiceDt)*100+MONTH(s.InvoiceDt),
         i.InvCategoryName
ORDER BY SortKey, NetSales DESC
note: Month-wise breakdown by category for last 3 complete months.

question: Which branch had the highest sales today?
sql:
SELECT TOP 1
  b.BranchShortName    AS Branch,
  SUM(s.SaleNetAmount) AS NetSales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.InvoiceId) AS Bills
FROM dbo.VwAISalesData s
JOIN dbo.VwAIBranch    b ON s.BranchId = b.BranchId
WHERE s.InvoiceDt = CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY b.BranchShortName
ORDER BY NetSales DESC
note: TOP 1 branch for today. Use TOP 5 for top 5 branches.
